infobox.usage: Unlocks the supply director's office on the second floor of the "Aspect" LLC building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Supply department director's office key (Supp.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the offices in the "Aspect" LLC building.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Office on the second floor of the "Aspect" LLC building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Drawer
- 1x Safe
- Loose loot (Provisions, Flammable materials)
